Checchi Capital Advisers Llc increased its stake in Pepsico Inc (PEP) by 24.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Checchi Capital Advisers Llc bought 2,899 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.24% with the market. The institutional investor held 14,898 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.79 million, up from 11,999 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Checchi Capital Advisers Llc who had been investing in Pepsico Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $137.16 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.06% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $96.74. About 1.23M shares traded. PepsiCo, Inc. (NYSE:PEP) has declined 3.75% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.30% the S&P500.
